---

Load required libraries

```{r echo=FALSE}

library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(readxl)
library(mapview)

```

Import data

```{r echo=FALSE}

# Vann-Nett report of streams physically altered for agriculture or roads
vann_nett <- read_excel("/data/P-Prosjekter2/155014_restaurerbar_natur_akershus/2026/Data/Ferskvann/vannnett_eksport.xlsx") %>% 
  filter(`Pressure type (pressures)` %in% c("Physical alteration for agriculture",
                                            "Physical intervention road (road in watercourse, culvert, etc.)")) %>% 
  rename(waterbody_id = `Waterbody id`) %>% 
  group_by(waterbody_id) %>% 
  slice(1) %>% 
  ungroup()

# Vannforekomster in Akershus
vann_for <- st_read("/data/P-Prosjekter2/155014_restaurerbar_natur_akershus/2026/Data/Ferskvann/Vannforekomster_32_akershus_25832_FILEGDB.gdb", layer = "VannforekomstElv")

```

Join geometry to vann_nett data

```{r echo=FALSE}

vann_sf <- vann_nett %>% 
  left_join(vann_for, by = c("waterbody_id" = "identifikasjon_lokalId")) %>% 
  st_as_sf(sf_column_name = "SHAPE", crs = 25832)

mapview(vann_sf)
```

Export

```{r echo=FALSE}

# write to scratch temporarily and copy to P drive
out_gpkg <- "/data/scratch/tmp_jenny/gpkg/rette_bekker.gpkg"
st_write(vann_sf, out_gpkg, layer = "rette_bekker")


file.copy(
  from = out_gpkg,
  to = "/data/P-Prosjekter2/155014_restaurerbar_natur_akershus/2026/Kriteriekart/rette_bekker.gpkg",
  overwrite = TRUE)

```
